job.location: Various School Sites in Newport Beach and Costa Mesa, CA

items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes

02. I understand that the employment days of this position area daily, Monday through Friday, and that the calendar year is 11 months (off portions of June/July depending on posted work calendar) Options: Yes, I understand this position is 11 months out of the year.
03. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
04. Has your education included college-level coursework in business, office management or related field? Options: Yes | No
05. How many years of verifiable increasingly responsible job related clerical or secretarial experience do you have? Options: Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 3-4 years | 5 years or more
06. Check the box that most closely matches your speed in typing or keyboarding. Options: Less than 40 wpm | 40-44 wpm | 45-49 wpm | 50-54 wpm | 55-59 wpm | 60-69 wpm | 70 wpm or faster

07. Check the box that indicates your level of proficiency with Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint). Options: None. I have no experience in working with Microsoft Office software products. | Beginner. Perform daily word processing tasks in Word, enter correct data, create a database, format cells, rows and columns in Excel; create a PowerPoint presentation file with a title slide, bullet points and place in slide loop mode; create a new email message, checking email in Outlook. | Intermediate. Basic formatting and create a variety of templates, mail merges in Word; create, modify and format charts, use graphic objects to enhance worksheets and charts in Excel; add special effects to presentation (design and animation) in PowerPoint; reply, forward, print and delete email messages in Outlook. | Advanced. Manage table data, sort and filter merges in Word; use the filter and formula functions to manipulate data in Excel; transition presentation slides, link Excel charts to presentation and add voice in PowerPoint; delete e-mails from the Inbox, Sent Items and Deleted Items folders, add, edit, move and delete appointments on your calendar in Outlook. | Expert. Produce table of contents, footnotes, endnotes, bookmarks in Word; use advance formula functions, manage macro commands, group rows in Excel; publish presentation online, embed objects into presentation in PowerPoint; manage multiple calendars, set rules for incoming mail, create subfolders for mail to be placed in Outlook.

08. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Proofreading, editing, and composing letters, flyers, and newsletter articles. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

09. Coordinate and schedule meetings, conferences, training sessions, etc. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

10. Screening calls and visitors and handling them or routing them to appropriate staff. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

11. Establishing priorities for carrying out multiple tasks in order to meet deadlines. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations

12. Ordering and maintaining inventories of office equipment, supplies, and contracts. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

13. Monitoring budget expenditures and keeping expenditure records. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

14. Interacting with and responding courteously to the general public on the phone and in person. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

15. I have the ability to perform oral and/or written translations to/from English and Spanish. (not required for all sites) Options: No bilingual ability | Oral Translation Only | Written Translation Only | Written and Oral Translation

16. How many years of verifiable work experience have you had in translating oral and written communication in English and Spanish? Options: no experience | less than 1 year | 2 - 3 years | 4 years or more

17. This position requires working with confidential information and sensitive situations. Describe, in detail, a time when it was most challenging to maintain confidentiality at work. How have you responded to others who have pressured you to provide them with confidential materials?

18. Describe you work related experience managing multiple projects with varying deadlines while ensuring accuracy of your work. Include the techniques you utilize to stay organized and be successful.

19. This position requires frequent interaction with students, parents, administrators and other staff. Describe your experience dealing with a variety of customers with diverse requests and needs. What techniques do you use to ensure excellent customer service for all stakeholders?
20. Describe your work related experience monitoring expenditures, initiating budget transfers and arranging expense reimbursements for a manager or administrator.
21. Describe specific actions you have taken to promote a cooperative team environment, even when others around you were negative or uncooperative. What did you do and what were the results?

ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Coordinate the overall office activities to assist the Principal in administrative tasks; prepare and maintain a variety of reports, records and files relating to students, staff, operations and activities including those of a confidential nature. Serve as secretary to the Principal; type letters, compose correspondence independently; prepare, type and distribute communications; schedule conferences, appointments and meetings; receive, open, prioritize and distribute mail. Answer telephones and greet visitors; take and relay messages; provide information to students, staff and the public concerning school policies, procedures, actions, activities and schedules as appropriate; maintain Principal's calendar and school master calendar of events. Collect, compile, organize and record a variety of data related to attendance, enrollment, personnel and student activities; prepare and maintain related records, files and logs; monitor, process and submit duplication orders; design and prepare certificates and other documents for special and seasonal events as assigned. Maintain payroll for certificated, classified and other personnel; maintain accurate records of substitute teachers and accounts to be charged; submit custodial vacation schedules; receive and distribute paychecks. Enroll, register and schedule new students; complete enrollment information; complete records for the release or transfer of students; maintain confidentiality of student information as required; prepare cumulative and health files as required; assist with orientation events as assigned; input residency and emergency contact information into an assigned database. Lead the activities of the office staff providing training, work direction, assure compliance with established procedures; assist in setting work priorities and provide input to performance evaluations. Perform or oversee the attendance function; notify parents of absences; input data and prepare related reports. Operate a variety of office equipment including a computer and assigned software. Collect and account for monies collected in conjunction with school activities according to established procedures; process, prepare and scan receipts and deposit slips; process field trips and initiate purchase orders as required. Maintain and update an assigned school website; upload relevant information in accordance with District policies and procedures; update user information; send emails, newsletters and calendars to appropriate individuals. Assist in orienting substitute personnel; provide keys, classroom rosters and instructional materials and maintain related records; submit substitute requests for staff development trainings as assigned. Assist individual students and parents to relate to the school program and its staff; refer the more difficult problems of adjustments to the principal or designated staff member. Maintain accurate and current student emergency release information and oversee the release of students to authorized parent/guardian or approved individual. Administer first aid and dispense approved medication to students in accordance with District policy; review medication forms and call doctor's office to assure proper dosages as required. Monitor budget and advise staff members of budget status; process orders, purchase requisitions and reconcile statements as required; assist the principal with the preparation and maintenance of financial, statistical and narrative reports. Enter Use of Facilities Permits for extracurricular programs; communicate with school personnel and outside organizations as required; generate work orders for facility and equipment repairs. Research, compile and verify a variety of information; compute statistical information for a variety of reports; process and evaluate a variety of forms and applications related to assigned functions; duplicate and distribute materials as needed. Prepare and maintain a variety of data, records and reports related to office programs, financial activity, student information, personnel and assigned duties; assure accuracy and completeness of data, records and reports; establish and maintain filing systems. Receive, sort and distribute mail; open mail and compose responses independently as appropriate; prepare and distribute informational packets and bulk mailings as directed. Provide clerical assistance to faculty and staff as needed. Requisition, receive, store and distribute supplies and office materials; maintain inventory records; assure receipt and proper distribution. OTHER DUTIES: Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Modern office practices, procedures and equipment. Statistical record keeping techniques. Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary. Oral and written communication skills. Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy. Telephone techniques and etiquette. District organization, operations, policies and objectives. Basic first aid techniques. Operation of standard office equipment including computer and assigned software. ABILITY TO: Perform a wide variety of clerical and secretarial duties to coordinate school office activities. Perform public relations and communications services for the Principal. Understand and follow oral and written directions. Compose correspondence independently. Complete work with many interruptions. Work independently with little direction. Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others. Type and input data at an acceptable rate of speed. Learn, interpret, apply and explain rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Operate a variety of office machines including a computer and assigned software. Understand and work within the scope of authority. Plan and organize work. Train and provide work direction to others. Work confidentially with discretion. Plan and organize work. Administer first aid. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Office environment. Constant interruptions. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment. Sitting for extended periods of time. Kneeling, bending at the waist, and reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally to retrieve and store files and supplies. Hearing and speaking to exchange information in person or on the telephone. Seeing to read, prepare and assure the accuracy of documents. HAZARDS: Contact with blood and bloodborne pathogens. Potential contact with communicable diseases. Contact with abusive individuals. Ewing Consulting, Inc. August 2016
